## Page + Item + List: streaming persistence

> Quick overview of how pages, lists and items work together for streaming persistence.

- **`Item`** (`core/Item`): an object with an id and a `data` bag. `item.set({title: "x"})` changes the data and emits a `change` event carrying the delta.
- **`List`** (`core/List`): `List extends Item`, so it is an Item that holds items. Its verbs `add`, `remove`, `move`, `order` each emit the line they save.
- **`Page`** (`core/Page`): `Page extends Item`. It has `pages` and `content` lists, so a page is an Item that holds Lists of Items.
- **Persistence:** every change is a one-line delta, appended to the page's `page.jsonl`. Nesting is the path, for example `{"k2": {"answers": {"add": {...}}}}`. The file is never rewritten.
- **Streaming:** the same appended line is the live update. `JSONL`'s `live()` tails the file, replays new lines into the object, and the view redraws. Saving and streaming are one write, which is the owner's point.
- **Errors:** a `page.log` that is a List of error-level Items would persist and stream with no new machinery. It still needs rules to keep it from growing without bound.

The design is in [page-item-design.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/page-item-design.md). The file layer is [ext/JSONL](/framework/ext/JSONL/) and [ext/Saver](/framework/ext/Saver/). Their readmes warn that file saving is scattered and should converge on one `FsFile`.
